name: icons8
description: Icons8 icons and Ouch! illustrations for coding agents, plus a design pass over what the agent built with them. Locks a project to one icon pack and one illustration style, rejects wrong metaphors and generic art, and checks the finished screen for emoji standing in for icons, missing images, dead placeholders, broken icon imports, keyboard reach, contrast and token drift, fixing what it finds from the catalogue. Bundles the Icons8 MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: One consistent icon and illustration set per project, from Icons8
interface.longDescription:
Turns the Icons8 MCP server into a workflow with taste, then checks what the agent built with it. Lists every icon a screen needs before searching, picks one pack for the whole project and locks it in icons8.json together with the illustration style, the sizes in use and the token names, filters every search by that pack so results are 10 different metaphors instead of 10 styles of one, rejects brand logos and mac-window screenshots where a plain symbol belongs, previews on free PNG and pulls SVG only for the set that survives. Illustrations follow the same discipline, animation included: one style per project, the video sources in an order that actually plays.

Seven more skills look at the finished screen. One runs by itself after a build and answers four mechanical questions: an emoji standing in for an icon, a section that should carry a picture and carries none, a dead image URL, an icon import whose name no longer exists in the library. Five go deeper, one territory each: behaviour and the six states, interface copy, visual finish and contrast, motion, design tokens. A front door routes a request to the one that owns it, so a narrow question does not load them all, and several running together return one table with one verdict instead of five stacked lists.
defaultPrompt: Add icons to this dashboard, one consistent Icons8 set, 24px.
Illustrate the empty states with one Ouch! style.
Check this screen: emoji icons, missing images, contrast.
